topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I thought I had found a way to make life a bit easier, a small bridge to connect the gaps. I poured my days and my nights into crafting, tweaking, testing, hoping that this could be my contribution. When I finally stood before the gatekeepers, proud and eager, they handed me a paper that felt heavier than lead. Someone, somewhere, had already walked this path, had already laid claim to the land I thought was mine. I should have looked more, searched deeper, before I started. Now, I’m just another wanderer on a road I thought was mine. I’ll start again, but I can’t help but look back at what could have been.
